panel.name: overlays_content
panel.text: Everything that draws Atmo Magic debug geometry, one switch each. The pickers and dials for each view are on the other tabs. The info readout's own orange headings collapse their section on click.

check_box.name: info_overlay_check
check_box.label: Show info overlay
check_box.tool_tip: On-screen readout of weather values, the maps' capture health, particle counts, lightning state and the indoor/outdoor probe result. Click an orange heading to collapse that section

check_box.name: flow_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the wind flowmap
check_box.tool_tip: The solved field drawn over the world - arrows or flow lines, capture passes, all picked on the Wind Flow tab

check_box.name: shadow_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the rain shadow map
check_box.tool_tip: Every captured depth texel drawn where it saw the world, in the view picked on the Rain tab

check_box.name: runoff_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the roof runoff
check_box.tool_tip: The eaves, the water they hold and what they shed, in the stage picked on the Rain tab

check_box.name: surface_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the surface field
check_box.tool_tip: The wet/snow/puddle landing grid and its runoff traces, drawn over the ground they land on

check_box.name: field_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the world field
check_box.tool_tip: The shared capture's view - band surfaces, air labels, drainage or true ground - picked on the Fields tab. The drainage and air views are distance-thinned

check_box.name: cloud_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the cloud field
check_box.tool_tip: The volumetric deck's builder views, picked on the Fields tab

check_box.name: settle_overlay_check
check_box.label: Mark geometry changes waiting to settle
check_box.tool_tip: A beacon over every prim change still waiting out its settle delay, green as it comes due and red once it has re-armed too often to ever settle

panel.text: World-space tags over things the systems are holding or doing right now.

check_box.name: strike_marker_check
check_box.label: Mark pending lightning strikes
check_box.tool_tip: Sheet strikes get a ring where the flash will bloom, forks their future channel, ground strikes the channel plus a box at the attachment point, each with a floating countdown in a colour of its own - chosen to read against white storm cloud

check_box.name: sheet_marker_check
check_box.label: Mark rain sheet trajectories
check_box.tool_tip: Per live rain-sheet particle, a thin cyan line along its whole intended trajectory, a thick magenta dot at its centre and a magenta heading line of one second's travel - for diagnosing whether sheets actually carry wind slant

check_box.name: footstep_marker_check
check_box.label: Mark footstep audio sources
check_box.tool_tip: A bright flash where a footstep sound starts playing, then a small dim dot riding the source until it stops - shows start moments, whether loops follow their avatar, and stop timing
